title: 更加, 不如, 相同 and 同样: more, less, the same
explain: 更加 'even more' is like 更 (HSK 3) but a little more formal. It goes before adjectives and some verbs: 天气更加冷了 'The weather is even colder'; 他更加努力了 'He works even harder'. It compares with an earlier state.
A 不如 B means 'A is not as good as B': 这个手机不如那个手机好用 'This phone is not as easy to use as that one'. An adjective can follow B: 我不如他高 'I am not as tall as he is'. Compare 没有 (HSK 2): 这个没有那个好.

相同 'the same, identical' and 同样 'in the same way, equally' say there is no difference: 我们的想法相同 'Our ideas are the same'; 他们同样很高兴 'They are equally happy'. 同样 can also come before a noun with 的: 同样的问题 'the same question'.

examples.zh: 天气更加冷了，多穿一点儿衣服吧。
examples.en: The weather is even colder now; wear a bit more clothing.

examples.zh: 这个手机不如那个手机好用。
examples.en: This phone is not as easy to use as that one.
Our ideas are exactly the same.

examples.zh: 他们对这件事同样感兴趣。
examples.en: They are equally interested in this matter.

mistakes: 不如 compares two things, so you need both A and B. 这个不如好 is incomplete; say 这个不如那个好.
相同 does not take 很: 很相同 is wrong. Say 完全相同 'exactly the same' or 不太相同 'not quite the same'.

q.en: He works even harder now than before.
I am not as tall as he is.
The meaning of these two characters is the same.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: This is not as good as that?
q.en: This is not as good as that.
Our ideas are the same.
q.explain: 相同 does not take 很.

title: 对于, 对…来说, 通过 and 随着: regarding, for, through, along with
explain: 对于 'regarding, as for' and 对 … 来说 'for, as far as … is concerned' name the person or topic that a judgement is about: 对于这个问题，我没有意见 'On this question, I have no opinion'; 对我来说，汉字很难 'For me, characters are hard'. 对…来说 is used with people; 对于 with topics.
通过 'through, by means of' tells the way you do something: 通过看电影，他学会了很多词 'By watching films, he has learned many words'. It also means 'to pass': 他通过了考试 'He passed the exam'.
随着 'along with, as' says that one thing changes together with another: 随着天气变冷，人们穿得越来越多 'As the weather gets cold, people wear more and more'. 随着 starts the sentence and is followed by a change.

examples.zh: 对于这个问题，我没有意见。
examples.en: On this question, I have no opinion.
For me, characters are hard.

examples.zh: 通过看电影，他学会了很多词。
examples.en: By watching films, he has learned many words.

examples.zh: 随着天气变冷，人们穿得越来越多。
examples.en: As the weather gets cold, people wear more and more.

mistakes: 对…来说 is for people: 对我来说, 对学生来说. Do not use it for a thing: 对天气来说 is wrong.
随着 needs a change after it. 随着天气 is not complete; say 随着天气变冷.

q.en: For me, this is very easy.
q.explain: 对 + person + 来说 gives the point of view.

q.zh: 通过看书，他学到了很多。
q.en: By reading, he learned a lot.
q.explain: 通过 + action = by means of.

q.zh: 随着他的汉语越来越好，他的朋友也越来越多。
q.en: As his Chinese gets better and better, he has more and more friends.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: On this matter, I agree?
q.en: On this matter, I agree.
q.explain: 对于 comes before the topic.

q.zh: 通过看电影，他学会了很多词。
q.en: By watching films, he has learned many words.
q.wrong: 通过看电影，他用学会了很多词。
q.explain: 通过 already means "by means of"; do not add 用.

title: 按照, 作为, 与…相比 and 使: according to, as, compared with, make
explain: 按照 'according to, in line with' is followed by a rule, a plan or an order, and then the action: 按照老师说的做 'Do it the way the teacher said'. 按照 is about following something. 根据 (HSK 3) is about the evidence a judgement rests on. 作为 'as, in the role of' says what role someone has: 作为学生，他应该努力学习 'As a student, he should study hard'.
与 … 相比 'compared with …' compares two things. 与 is the written form of 和, and 和 … 相比 is the spoken one: 与去年相比，今年的雨多了 'Compared with last year, there is more rain this year'.
使 'to make, to cause' is followed by a person and then a feeling or a state: 这个消息使我很高兴 'This news makes me very happy'. The subject is a thing or an event, not a person who acts on purpose.

examples.en: Please do it the way the teacher says.

examples.zh: 作为学生，他应该努力学习。
examples.en: As a student, he should study hard.

examples.zh: 与去年相比，今年的雨多了。
examples.en: Compared with last year, there is more rain this year.
This news makes me very happy.

mistakes: 使 is followed by a person and then the result. For a person who makes someone do a job, use 让.
与…相比 needs both parts: 与去年相比, then what is different.

q.en: Please do it the way I say.

q.zh: 作为朋友，我应该帮助你。
q.en: As a friend, I should help you.

q.zh: 这个好消息使大家都很高兴。
q.en: This good news makes everyone happy.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: Compared with last year, I am busier now?
q.en: Compared with last year, I am busier now.

q.zh: 与去年相比，今年的雨多了。
q.en: Compared with last year, there is more rain this year.
q.wrong: 与去年相比，今年的雨是多了。
q.explain: 相比 already makes the comparison; do not add 是.

title: 一…就… and 任何 / 随便: as soon as, any, as you like
explain: 一 … 就 … links two actions that follow each other closely: 我一到家就给你打电话 'I will call you as soon as I get home'. It also means 'whenever': 他一累就想睡觉 'Whenever he is tired, he wants to sleep'. Put 一 before the first verb and 就 before the second.
The two verbs can have the same subject or different ones: 一下课，他就去打球 'As soon as class is over, he goes to play ball'.

任何 'any, whatever' is followed by a noun and then 都 or 也: 任何人都可以来 'Anyone can come'; 我没有任何问题 'I have no questions at all'. 随便 'as you like, casual' means there is no limit: 你随便坐 'Sit wherever you like'.

examples.zh: 我一到家就给你打电话。
examples.en: I will call you as soon as I get home.
Whenever he is tired, he wants to sleep.
Anyone can come.
Sit wherever you like; do not stand on ceremony.

mistakes: Do not leave out 就 in the second part. 我一到家给你打电话 is not natural.
任何 needs 都 or 也 after the noun: 任何人可以来 is not complete.

q.en: As soon as class is over, he goes to play basketball.
I understand as soon as I look.
Call me as soon as you arrive.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: Anyone can come?
q.en: Anyone can come.
Whenever he is tired, he wants to sleep.
q.explain: 一…就… already shows the link; do not add 所以.

title: 所有, 各, 一切, 许多, 大量, 部分, 全部 and 整个: all and many
explain: 所有 'all, every' comes before a noun and usually goes with 的 and 都: 所有的学生都来了 'All the students have come'. 各 'each, every one of' is used with a few nouns: 各国 'every country', 各位 'everyone'. 一切 'everything, all' stands for the whole of something: 一切都很好 'Everything is fine'.
许多 'many, a lot of' and 大量 'a large amount of' say that there is a lot. 许多 goes before nouns: 许多人 'many people'. 大量 is more formal and goes with amounts: 大量的时间 'a lot of time'.

部分 'part', 全部 'all of it' and 整个 'the whole' say how much of a thing: 我只看了一部分 'I only watched part of it'; 他吃了全部的菜 'He ate all the dishes'; 整个下午 'the whole afternoon'. 整个 takes one thing as a whole; 全部 is for the whole set.

examples.en: All the students have come.
Everything is fine; please rest assured.
He has many friends.
I slept the whole afternoon.

mistakes: 所有 and 一切 usually need 都 in the sentence: 所有的学生来了 is not natural.
整个 takes one thing as a whole. For a whole set of things use 全部.

q.en: Everyone likes him.

q.zh: 他花了大量的时间学习。
q.en: He spent a lot of time studying.

q.zh: 我写了整个下午的作业。
q.en: I wrote homework the whole afternoon.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: Everything is fine?
q.en: Everything is fine.
q.explain: 都 goes before the verb or adjective.

q.en: He has many friends.
q.explain: 许多 already means "many"; do not add 很.

title: 有的…有的… and 互相 / 共同: some … others, each other
explain: 有的 … 有的 … 'some … others …' splits a group into parts: 有的人喜欢夏天，有的人喜欢冬天 'Some people like summer, others like winter'. 有些 'some' works in the same pattern. You can leave out the noun after the second 有的.
互相 'each other, mutually' goes before the verb: 我们互相帮助 'We help each other'; 朋友们互相学习 'Friends learn from each other'. 互相 already means 'each other', so no object is needed.

共同 'common, together' works as an adjective or an adverb: 我们有共同的爱好 'We have a common hobby'; 大家共同努力 'Everyone works hard together'. 共同 is more formal than 一起 and stresses sharing the same goal or thing.

examples.zh: 有的人喜欢夏天，有的人喜欢冬天。
examples.en: Some people like summer, others like winter.

examples.zh: 这些书，有的好，有的不好。
examples.en: Of these books, some are good and some are not.

examples.zh: 我们互相帮助，一起学习汉语。
examples.en: We help each other and study Chinese together.
We have a common hobby.

mistakes: 有的 … 有的 … needs two or more parts. One 有的 alone does not make the pattern; say 有的…，有的….
互相 goes before the verb, not after: 我们帮助互相 is wrong.

q.zh: 有的人喜欢夏天，有的人喜欢冬天。
q.en: Some people like summer and some like winter.
q.explain: 有的 … 有的 … splits the group.

q.en: Friends help each other.
q.explain: 互相 goes before the verb.

q.en: We have friends in common.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: We learn from each other?
q.en: We learn from each other.
q.explain: 互相 goes before the verb.

q.en: We help each other.
q.explain: 互相 goes straight before the verb; do not add 是.

title: 之前, 之后, 之间, 当时, 从此 and 接着: before, after, between, then
explain: 之前 'before' and 之后 'after' go after a time or an action: 三点之前 'before three o'clock'; 吃饭之前，先洗手 'Before eating, wash your hands first'; 下课之后 'after class'. They work like 以前 and 以后 (HSK 3) but are a little more formal.

之间 'between, among' goes after two things or two limits: 房子和学校之间 'between the house and the school'; 三点到五点之间 'between three and five'. 当时 'at that time, then' points back to a time already named: 我十岁的时候搬到这里，当时这里很小 'I moved here when I was ten; at that time it was small'.

从此 'from then on' says that after one event a new situation began: 他来到这里，从此没有离开 'He came here, and from then on has not left'. 接着 'next, then' follows the action just before it: 他先吃饭，接着看电视 'He eats first, then watches TV'.

examples.en: Before eating, wash your hands first.
After class, we go and eat.

examples.zh: 我十岁的时候搬到这里，当时这里很小。
examples.en: I moved here when I was ten; at that time it was small.
He eats first, then watches TV.

mistakes: 之前 and 之后 come after the time or action: 之前吃饭 is wrong. Say 吃饭之前.
从此 is for a turning point in the past. Do not use it for a plan; for the future say 以后.

q.en: Before going to bed, I must take a shower.
q.explain: 之前 comes after the action.

q.en: After class, he goes to play ball.
q.explain: 之后 comes after the action.

q.zh: 房子和学校之间有一个公园。
q.en: Between the house and the school there is a park.
q.explain: 之间 goes after the two things.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: He ate, and then watched TV?
q.en: He ate, and then watched TV.
q.explain: 接着 follows the first action.

q.en: Before eating, wash your hands first.
q.explain: 之前 already means "before"; do not add 以前.

title: 说明, 表示 and 成为: shows, says, becomes
explain: 说明 has two uses: 'to explain' (请你说明一下 'Please explain') and 'to show that' something is true (这件事说明他很努力 'This shows that he works hard'). With a clause after it, it is a conclusion drawn from facts.
表示 'to express, to show' says what someone shows by words or acts: 他点头表示同意 'He nods to show agreement'; 他表示不同意 'He says he does not agree'. The subject is a person, or an act that shows a feeling.
成为 'to become' is followed by a noun, a job or a role: 他成为了一名医生 'He became a doctor'. For adjectives use 变得: 天气变得很冷 'The weather has become cold'.

examples.en: This shows that he works hard.

examples.zh: 请你说明一下这个问题。
examples.en: Please explain this problem.
He nods to show agreement.

examples.zh: 他后来成为了一名医生。
examples.en: Later he became a doctor.

mistakes: 成为 is followed by a noun or a role, not an adjective: 他成为很高 is wrong. Say 他变得很高.
说明 for "explain" needs a thing to explain; 说明 for "show that" needs a clause after it.

q.zh: 他的成绩说明他很努力。
q.en: His results show that he works hard.
He nods to show agreement.

q.zh: 她后来成为了一名老师。
q.en: Later she became a teacher.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: This shows that it is hard?
q.en: This shows that it is hard.
He wants to become a doctor.
q.explain: 成为 is followed straight by the noun; do not add 是.

title: Words you know, with a new meaning
explain: Some words you already know come back in HSK 4 with another meaning or another sound. The character is the same; the words around it tell you which one it is.

空 kòng means 'free time, a gap': 有空 'to be free', 没空 'to have no time'. 空 kōng is 'empty': 空的 'empty'. 重 chóng means 'again': 重新 'anew', 重来 'do it again'. 重 zhòng is 'heavy'. 干 gān means 'dry': 衣服干了 'The clothes are dry'; 干净 'clean' is gān too. 干 gàn is 'to do': 干什么.

等 děng at the end of a list means 'and so on, etc.': 苹果、西瓜等水果 'fruits such as apples and watermelons'. 生 also means 'raw' and 'unfamiliar': 生的 'raw', 生词 'a new word'. 种 zhòng means 'to plant': 种花 'plant flowers'. 种 zhǒng is 'kind': 这种水果.

着 zháo means 'to succeed in': 睡着 'fall asleep', 找着 'find'. 着 zhe shows a state: 门开着. 为 wéi means 'to be, to act as': 成为 'become', 作为 'as'. 为 wèi is 'for': 为你高兴. 两 liǎng is also a Chinese unit of weight, 50 grams: 二两 'two liang'. 啊 ā at the start of a sentence is a cry of surprise: 啊！是你！ 'Ah! It is you!'

examples.en: Are you free tomorrow?
The clothes are dry now; you can wear them.

examples.zh: 我喜欢苹果、西瓜等水果。
examples.en: I like fruits such as apples and watermelons.

examples.zh: 他在花园里种了很多花。
examples.en: He planted many flowers in the garden.

mistakes: The sound is decided by the words around: 你有空吗 is kòng, 杯子是空的 is kōng. 他睡着了 is zháo, 门开着 is zhe.
为 wèi 'for' goes before a person: 为你高兴. 成为 and 作为 use wéi.

q.en: Are you free tomorrow?
q.explain: 有空 kòng = to be free.

q.en: The clothes are dry now; you can wear them.

q.zh: 我喜欢苹果、西瓜等水果。
q.en: I like fruits such as apples and watermelons.
q.explain: 等 děng after a list = and so on.

q.zh: 他在花园里种了很多花。
q.en: He planted many flowers in the garden.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: He has fallen asleep?
q.en: He has fallen asleep.
q.explain: 睡着 zháo = to fall asleep.
